parameters.content:
## NWI - BC Contacts -> HubSpot contacts (daily): set up before publishing
1. Connect credentials: **HubSpot Service Key account** (contacts read/write) and **Business Central – NWI Group (client credentials)**. Confirm no "not connected" warning on any node.
2. Settings -> Error Workflow: set the shared error handler (not set in this file). Settings -> Timezone: Australia/Sydney, so midnight means midnight Sydney.
3. BC web service **Contact_Card** (page 5050, name set in Workflow Config as bcContactPage) must be published: Segment and Sub Segment are read from it. Confirm the field names `Segment` and `Sub_Segment` exist there.
4. HubSpot contact property `business_central_record_id` holds the BC contact number and is how a record is matched. Segment / Sub Segment (`sub_segment`) are HubSpot dropdowns: a BC value HubSpot does not list fails that batch.
5. **Workflow Config** holds the lookback window (25h = daily run + 1h overlap), batch size and the BC-field -> HubSpot-property map.

**What it does:** finds BC contacts created or changed in the last 25 hours, finds the matching HubSpot contacts by `business_central_record_id`, and updates only the properties whose value differs. BC wins. A blank in BC never clears HubSpot. HubSpot records are never created. Safe to re-run.

nodes.name: Every Day At Midnight
nodes.notes: Runs once a day at midnight (set the workflow timezone to Australia/Sydney). Production runs only - publish the workflow.

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: lookbackHours: how far back to look (25 = daily run + 1h overlap). matchProperty: HubSpot property holding the BC number. fieldMap: BC field -> HubSpot property.

nodes.name: List Changed BC Contacts

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.value: ={{ "type eq 'Person' and lastModifiedDateTime ge " + $now.minus({ hours: Number($('Workflow Config').first().json.lookbackHours) }).toUTC().toISO() }}

nodes.notes: One call: every contact created or modified in the window. Segment and Sub Segment are read in the next step (they are not in the standard API).

nodes.name: Build BC Read Batches
nodes.notes: Splits the contact numbers into batches (batchSize each). One item per batch.

nodes.name: Read BC Contact Details
nodes.notes: One call per batch: Segment and Sub Segment from the BC contact card web service (name set in Workflow Config: bcContactPage).

nodes.name: Find Matching Contacts
nodes.notes: Read-only search (POST is only the HubSpot search convention): one call finds the HubSpot records for a whole batch.

nodes.name: Compare And Build Updates
nodes.notes: Keeps only properties that differ. Blank BC values are ignored. No changes = no output, so the next node does not run.

nodes.name: Update HubSpot Contacts
nodes.notes: Batch update, up to 100 contacts per call. Updates only: records are never created. Setting the same value twice is harmless, so retry is safe.

parameters.content:
## 1. Find changed BC contacts
One call lists everything created or modified in the lookback window.

## 2. Find the HubSpot records
One search per batch of 100 contacts.

## 3. Write only what changed
Compares BC to HubSpot and updates up to 100 records per call.
